moments.author: LeBron James
moments.quote: Welcome to Polymarket HQ. Coming soon. In partnership with @Polymarket
moments.why: A‑list athlete teasing first individual prediction‑market partnership, igniting massive reaction among sports and finance fans.

moments.author: Kawhi Leonard
moments.quote: I accept full responsibility for lapses in judgment by people within my inner circle and regret the distraction this situation has caused the fans and my family.
moments.why: His admission follows heavy NBA sanctions for Clippers cap violations — a rare public mea culpa from a star and trending hot take.

moments.author: Aaron Donald
moments.quote: He’s back: Rams star Aaron Donald is coming out of retirement and returning on a one‑year, $20M deal (up to $30M with incentives).
moments.why: Legendary defensive lineman ending retirement shocks sports world and reignites Super Bowl hopes for Rams.

moments.author: Jason Whitlock
moments.quote: "That is a picture a little girl gets of the American flag on a woman's chest" — blasting Team USA for 'turning the locker room into a strip club'.
moments.why: Outrageous sports commentary criticizing Team USA's locker‑room video, stirring cultural debate especially among male fans.
